name: Cell Knights: TD
detailed_description:
Welcome to Cell Knights: TD, where tower defense gets flipped inside out! When a traitor unleashes a contagious plague, turning good cells into brainless attackers, it’s up to you—Chief Advisor to the Cell King—to reclaim lost outposts and find the culprit.

But forget building walls—your towers are knights! The Frost Tower slows enemies, the Axe Tower spins them silly, and the Blaze Tower? Well… it burns enemies so hard they run faster! (Who knew fire was such a great motivator?) With Dr. Rus developing an antidote, your job is to turn these towers into the kingdom’s last hope! Are you ready to cell-ebrate victory, or will the infection divide and conquer?

The game is still in progress but here's some of the content of this game:

Features:

  • Single-player campaign – Reclaim lost outposts and uncover the truth behind the outbreak.

  • Path-mazing tower defense – Build defenses that shape enemy movement to your advantage.

  • Unique towers with wacky mechanics – Cell Knights that pop, freeze, spin, smash, clean, reveal, and accidentally speed up enemies!

  • Strategic gameplay – Carefully choose and place your knights to outsmart the infection.

  • Level Editor - After completing the main campaign a level editor will be unlocked

Future Features (If got enough fund):

  • Co-op mode – Team up with friends to protect the kingdom together!

  • Multiplayer battles – Challenge others in strategic head-to-head tower defense duels.

  • More knights & abilities – Expand your arsenal with new cell knights and crazy skills.

  • Endless mode – Survive as long as possible against waves of infected!

It’s time to think outside the petri dish—Cell Knights: TD is the most infectious tower defense game yet!

⚔️ Demo coming soon! Get ready to cell-ebrate victory in the wackiest tower defense game yet!

P.S. I'm an indie developer, and you can follow my progress on YouTube at Nutsaid! Hit that subscribe button to stay updated on Cell Knights: TD and more! 🚀

short_description: Cell Knights: TD is a Isometric 2.5D cozy tower defense game. Inspired by clash of clans clay like art style in a Warcraft 3 TD Gameplay. Build and strategize your maze, place your towers correctly with each has their own unique shooting mechanics. Perfect for someone who loves tower defense game.
